title: Evaluation of the influence of vitamin D level on the success rate of dental Implants. A multi-center clinical trial.
summary: This study investigates the influence of the vitamin D level in the blood on the remodeling processes after implantation. The focus here is on soft tissue and bone.

interventions.name:
The presurgical evaluation includes clinical observation and obtaining capillary blood. This
procedure is the classical way of using lancet on the fingertip. The 25 OH vitamin D level
will then be determined within the clinic of implant surgery, clinic of maxillofacial surgery of the Johannes Gute

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
patients requiring dental implants
patients were willing to participate in this study, and no condition that would preclude them from implant therapy
Exclusion criteria:
osteogenesis-related diseases or taking medications that affect bone formation
history of oromaxillofacial radiation therapy
severe bruxism or clenching
women during pregnancy
